statement: A public-repository redaction guard must scan the same Git-tracked surface that can leak. In incident #984, src/__tests__/experiment-doc-path-redaction-guard.test.ts enumerated only eight experiment artifacts, so docs/orchestration/status/cejel-hardening/c2-http-mcp-phase-a.md and scripts/{d-series-base-rate-prepare,session-trace-extract,session-trace-extract.node-test,session-trace-oracle,session-trace-resolve,session-trace-source-manifest,stratum-b-egbert-oracle,stratum-b-extract,stratum-b-ledger,stratum-b-oracle}.mjs remained uncovered. Add a Git-tracked-file search, use the established operator-home placeholder in prose, derive executable roots from the runtime home, and prove the repair with a committed forbidden specimen. Move condition: after the repair PR merges, verify its origin/main squash diff exhibits those changes, then anchor and copy this record into Alfred's maeve-lesson-batches with the cejel_ prefix.
